title: synth.metro~
description: `synth.metro~` is a ready-to-use metronome synthesizer that generates distinct downbeat, on-beat, and off-beat sounds, with a signal output and a second outlet reporting the current beat type. Start or stop it with 1 or 0, and set its tempo and time signature through arguments or properties such as `@tempo` and `@tsig`; individual beat sounds can also be played manually.
